about.p1: I am <1>Francisco Pandol</1> — a <2>Software Project Leader and Backend Tech Lead</2> with <3>over ten years</3> owning architecture and delivery in <4>fintech, real-time systems, and marketplace-scale backends</4>. I lead with <5>Python, Django, and FastAPI</5>, and I am comfortable making the calls that affect scalability, latency, and operational safety — the same profile that matters for large product and payments platforms.
about.p2: I have led teams on the <1>Mercado Libre ecosystem</1> (RealTrends), shipped exchange-grade backends with custody and KYC integrations, and improved platform performance at scale (including significant gains on wealth-management workloads). I stay close to code and reviews while aligning engineering with business outcomes.

lebenslauf-generator.name: CV Generator
lebenslauf-generator.problem: Professionals need portable, version-controlled CVs that render consistently across formats — without locking content into proprietary tools.
lebenslauf-generator.solution: Built an open-source CLI and in-browser app: Pydantic validates the JSON source, Jinja2 renders it, WeasyPrint exports PDF, and a Pyodide-powered web app runs the whole pipeline client-side with no server.
lebenslauf-generator.impact: Demonstrates end-to-end Python tooling — schema validation, templating, PDF generation — plus WebAssembly delivery for zero-dependency distribution.

readme-enhancer.name: README Enhancer
readme-enhancer.problem: Most open-source projects ship with weak or missing README files, hurting adoption and contributor onboarding.
readme-enhancer.solution: Built a Go CLI that reads repository content and rewrites the README using the OpenAI API, producing structured, informative documentation in one command.
readme-enhancer.impact: Shows Go engineering and practical AI API integration: a self-contained tool developers can run in seconds against any repo.

chicago-artworks.name: Chicago Artworks Explorer
chicago-artworks.problem: Public cultural datasets like the Art Institute of Chicago API are rarely exposed through clean, usable interfaces.
chicago-artworks.solution: Full-stack app with a TypeScript/Node.js backend and React frontend, surfacing the museum's public API with search and browsing.
chicago-artworks.impact: Demonstrates end-to-end JS/TS development — from API integration to UI delivery — across the full stack in a single project.
